#define MICROPY_HW_MCU_NAME                     "STM32N647X0"

#define MICROPY_GC_STACK_ENTRY_TYPE             uint32_t
#define MICROPY_ALLOC_GC_STACK_SIZE             (128)
#define MICROPY_FATFS_EXFAT                     (1)

#define MICROPY_HW_ENABLE_INTERNAL_FLASH_STORAGE (0)
#define MICROPY_HW_HAS_SWITCH                   (1)
#define MICROPY_HW_HAS_FLASH                    (1)
#define MICROPY_HW_ENABLE_RNG                   (1)
#define MICROPY_HW_ENABLE_RTC                   (1)
#define MICROPY_HW_ENABLE_DAC                   (0)
#define MICROPY_HW_ENABLE_USB                   (1)
#define MICROPY_HW_ENABLE_SDCARD                (1)
#define MICROPY_PY_PYB_LEGACY                   (0)

#define MICROPY_BOARD_EARLY_INIT                board_early_init
#define MICROPY_BOARD_LEAVE_STANDBY             board_leave_standby()

// HSE is 48MHz, this gives a CPU frequency of 800MHz.
#define MICROPY_HW_CLK_PLLM                     (6)
#define MICROPY_HW_CLK_PLLN                     (100)
#define MICROPY_HW_CLK_PLLP1                    (1)
#define MICROPY_HW_CLK_PLLP2                    (1)
#define MICROPY_HW_CLK_PLLFRAC                  (0)

// The LSE is a 32kHz crystal.
#define MICROPY_HW_RTC_USE_LSE                  (1)
#define MICROPY_HW_RTC_USE_US                   (1)

// External SPI flash, MX25UM25645G (256Mbit = 32MB).
#define MICROPY_HW_XSPIFLASH_SIZE_BITS_LOG2     (28)

// SPI flash, block device config.
#define MICROPY_HW_BDEV_SPIFLASH                (&spi_bdev)
#define MICROPY_HW_BDEV_SPIFLASH_EXTENDED       (&spi_bdev)
#define MICROPY_HW_BDEV_SPIFLASH_CONFIG         (&spiflash_config)
#define MICROPY_HW_BDEV_SPIFLASH_OFFSET_BYTES   (4 * 1024 * 1024)
#define MICROPY_HW_BDEV_SPIFLASH_SIZE_BYTES     (4 * 1024 * 1024)

// UART buses
#define MICROPY_HW_UART1_TX                     (pyb_pin_UART1_TX)
#define MICROPY_HW_UART1_RX                     (pyb_pin_UART1_RX)
#define MICROPY_HW_UART3_TX                     (pyb_pin_UART3_TX)
#define MICROPY_HW_UART3_RX                     (pyb_pin_UART3_RX)
#define MICROPY_HW_UART7_TX                     (pyb_pin_UART7_TX)
#define MICROPY_HW_UART7_RX                     (pyb_pin_UART7_RX)
#define MICROPY_HW_UART_REPL                    (PYB_UART_1)
#define MICROPY_HW_UART_REPL_BAUD               (115200)

// I2C buses
#define MICROPY_HW_I2C2_SCL                     (pyb_pin_I2C2_SCL)
#define MICROPY_HW_I2C2_SDA                     (pyb_pin_I2C2_SDA)
#define MICROPY_HW_I2C4_SCL                     (pyb_pin_I2C4_SCL)
#define MICROPY_HW_I2C4_SDA                     (pyb_pin_I2C4_SDA)

// SPI buses
#define MICROPY_HW_SPI5_NSS                     (pyb_pin_SPI5_NSS)
#define MICROPY_HW_SPI5_SCK                     (pyb_pin_SPI5_SCK)
#define MICROPY_HW_SPI5_MISO                    (pyb_pin_SPI5_MISO)
#define MICROPY_HW_SPI5_MOSI                    (pyb_pin_SPI5_MOSI)

#define MICROPY_BANNER_MACHINE \
    MICROPY_HW_BOARD_NAME " with " MICROPY_HW_MCU_NAME "\r\n" \
    "====================================================== \r\n" \
    "    _  _____ _  __    ____ _____ __  __ _________      \r\n" \
    "   / \\|_   _| |/ /   / ___|_   _|  \\/  |___ /___ \\  \r\n" \
    "  / _ \\ | | | ' /____\\___ \\ | | | |\\/| | |_ \\ __) |\r\n" \
    " / ___ \\| | | . \\_____|__) || | | |  | |___) / __/   \r\n" \
    "/_/__ \\_\\_|_|_|\\_\\   |____/_|_|_|_| _|_|____/_____|\r\n" \
    "|  _ \\| \\ | | \\ | |      / /_ | || |___  |          \r\n" \
    "| | | |  \\| |  \\| |_____| '_ \\| || |_ / /           \r\n" \
    "| |_| | |\\  | |\\  |_____| (_) |__   _/ /             \r\n" \
    "|____/|_| \\_|_| \\_|      \\___/   |_|/_/             \r\n" \
    "====================================================== \r\n" \
    "        Author:GraysonWarner     version:v1.1          \r\n" \
    "    https://github.com/Mrpli/atk-dnn647-micropython    \r\n" \
    "====================================================== \r\n"

// LEDs: LED0=PG10, LED1=PE10 (active low).
#define MICROPY_HW_LED1                         (pyb_pin_LED0)
#define MICROPY_HW_LED2                         (pyb_pin_LED1)
#define MICROPY_HW_LED_ON(pin)                  (mp_hal_pin_low(pin))
#define MICROPY_HW_LED_OFF(pin)                 (mp_hal_pin_high(pin))

// User switch: KEY0 (PC6), active low (pressed = GND).
#define MICROPY_HW_USRSW_PIN                    (pyb_pin_KEY0)
#define MICROPY_HW_USRSW_PULL                   (GPIO_PULLUP)
#define MICROPY_HW_USRSW_EXTI_MODE              (GPIO_MODE_IT_FALLING)
#define MICROPY_HW_USRSW_PRESSED                (0)

// USB config
#define MICROPY_HW_USB_HS                       (1)
#define MICROPY_HW_USB_HS_IN_FS                 (1)
#define MICROPY_HW_USB_MAIN_DEV                 (USB_PHY_HS_ID)

// SD Card (SDMMC1)
#define MICROPY_HW_SDCARD_SDMMC                 (1)
#define MICROPY_HW_SDCARD_CK                    (pyb_pin_SDMMC1_CK)
#define MICROPY_HW_SDCARD_CMD                   (pyb_pin_SDMMC1_CMD)
#define MICROPY_HW_SDCARD_D0                    (pyb_pin_SDMMC1_D0)
#define MICROPY_HW_SDCARD_D1                    (pyb_pin_SDMMC1_D1)
#define MICROPY_HW_SDCARD_D2                    (pyb_pin_SDMMC1_D2)
#define MICROPY_HW_SDCARD_D3                    (pyb_pin_SDMMC1_D3)

#define MICROPY_HW_ENABLE_SDCARD                (1)

// Ethernet via RMII (PHY: onboard)
#define MICROPY_HW_ETH_MDC                      (pin_H5)
#define MICROPY_HW_ETH_MDIO                     (pin_F4)
#define MICROPY_HW_ETH_RMII_REF_CLK             (pin_F7)
#define MICROPY_HW_ETH_RMII_CRS_DV              (pin_F10)
#define MICROPY_HW_ETH_RMII_RXD0                (pin_F14)
#define MICROPY_HW_ETH_RMII_RXD1                (pin_F15)
#define MICROPY_HW_ETH_RMII_TX_EN               (pin_F11)
#define MICROPY_HW_ETH_RMII_TXD0                (pin_F12)
#define MICROPY_HW_ETH_RMII_TXD1                (pin_F13)

/******************************************************************************/
// Bootloader configuration

#define MBOOT_BOARD_EARLY_INIT(initial_r0)      mboot_board_early_init()

#define MBOOT_SPIFLASH_CS                       (pyb_pin_XSPIM_P2_CS)
#define MBOOT_SPIFLASH_SCK                      (pyb_pin_XSPIM_P2_SCK)
#define MBOOT_SPIFLASH_MOSI                     (pyb_pin_XSPIM_P2_IO0)
#define MBOOT_SPIFLASH_MISO                     (pyb_pin_XSPIM_P2_IO1)
#define MBOOT_SPIFLASH_ADDR                     (0x70000000)
#define MBOOT_SPIFLASH_BYTE_SIZE                (32 * 1024 * 1024)
#define MBOOT_SPIFLASH_LAYOUT                   "/0x70000000/8192*4Kg"
#define MBOOT_SPIFLASH_ERASE_BLOCKS_PER_PAGE    (1)
#define MBOOT_SPIFLASH_SPIFLASH                 (&spi_bdev.spiflash)
#define MBOOT_SPIFLASH_CONFIG                   (&spiflash_config)

/******************************************************************************/
// Function and variable declarations

extern const struct _mp_spiflash_config_t spiflash_config;

void mboot_board_early_init(void);

1	# Without mboot, the main firmware must fit in 512k flash, will be copied to SRAM by
2	# the hardware bootloader, and will run from SRAM.  With mboot, the main firmware can
3	# be much larger and will run from flash via XSPI in memory-mapped mode.
4	USE_MBOOT ?= 1
5	
6	MCU_SERIES = n6
7	CMSIS_MCU = STM32N647xx
8	AF_FILE = boards/stm32n657_af.csv
9	ifeq ($(BUILDING_MBOOT),1)
10	SYSTEM_FILE = $(STM32LIB_CMSIS_BASE)/Source/Templates/system_stm32$(MCU_SERIES)xx_fsbl.o
11	else
12	SYSTEM_FILE = $(STM32LIB_CMSIS_BASE)/Source/Templates/system_stm32$(MCU_SERIES)xx_s.o
13	endif
14	STM32_N6_HEADER_VERSION = 2.3
15	# NOTE: Copy MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr from
16	# Demo_Cubeide/ATK-DNN647_board/Software_Package/External_Loader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B/Binary/
17	# to $(STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER)/bin/ExternalLoader/ before deploying.
18	DKEL = $(STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER)/bin/ExternalLoader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr
19	
20	ifeq ($(USE_MBOOT),1)
21	LD_FILES = boards/stm32n657x0.ld boards/common_n6_flash.ld
22	TEXT0_ADDR = 0x70080000
23	else
24	LD_FILES = boards/stm32n657x0.ld boards/common_basic.ld
25	TEXT0_ADDR = 0x34180400
26	endif
27	
28	# ---- IMX335 camera driver (main firmware only, not mboot) ------------------
29	ifneq ($(BUILDING_MBOOT),1)
30	CAMERA_DIR = $(BOARD_DIR)/camera
31	
32	SRC_C += \
33	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/cmw_camera.c \
34	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/cmw_utils.c \
35	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/sensors/cmw_imx335.c \
36	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/sensors/imx335/imx335.c \
37	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/sensors/imx335/imx335_reg.c \
38	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Src/isp_algo.c \
39	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Src/isp_cmd_parser.c \
40	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Src/isp_core.c \
41	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Src/isp_services.c \
42	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/modcamera.c \
43	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/stubs.c
44	
45	INC += \
46	    -I$(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW \
47	    -I$(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/sensors \
48	    -I$(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/sensors/imx335 \
49	    -I$(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Inc
50	
51	LIBS += \
52	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Lib/libn6-evision-st-ae_gcc.a \
53	    $(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Lib/libn6-evision-awb_gcc.a
54	LIBS += $(shell $(CC) $(CFLAGS) -print-file-name=libm.a)
55	endif
56	
57	# MicroPython settings
58	MICROPY_FLOAT_IMPL = double
59	MICROPY_PY_LWIP = 1
60	MICROPY_PY_SSL = 1
61	MICROPY_SSL_MBEDTLS = 1

# Without mboot, the main firmware must fit in 512k flash, will be copied to SRAM by
# the hardware bootloader, and will run from SRAM.  With mboot, the main firmware can
# be much larger and will run from flash via XSPI in memory-mapped mode.
USE_MBOOT ?= 1

MCU_SERIES = n6
CMSIS_MCU = STM32N647xx
AF_FILE = boards/stm32n657_af.csv
ifeq ($(BUILDING_MBOOT),1)
SYSTEM_FILE = $(STM32LIB_CMSIS_BASE)/Source/Templates/system_stm32$(MCU_SERIES)xx_fsbl.o
else
SYSTEM_FILE = $(STM32LIB_CMSIS_BASE)/Source/Templates/system_stm32$(MCU_SERIES)xx_s.o
endif
STM32_N6_HEADER_VERSION = 2.3
# NOTE: Copy MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr from
# Demo_Cubeide/ATK-DNN647_board/Software_Package/External_Loader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B/Binary/
# to $(STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER)/bin/ExternalLoader/ before deploying.
DKEL = $(STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER)/bin/ExternalLoader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr

ifeq ($(USE_MBOOT),1)
LD_FILES = boards/stm32n657x0.ld boards/common_n6_flash.ld
TEXT0_ADDR = 0x70080000
else
LD_FILES = boards/stm32n657x0.ld boards/common_basic.ld
TEXT0_ADDR = 0x34180400
endif

# ---- IMX335 camera driver (main firmware only, not mboot) ------------------
ifneq ($(BUILDING_MBOOT),1)
CAMERA_DIR = $(BOARD_DIR)/camera

SRC_C += \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/cmw_camera.c \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/cmw_utils.c \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/sensors/cmw_imx335.c \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/sensors/imx335/imx335.c \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/sensors/imx335/imx335_reg.c \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Src/isp_algo.c \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Src/isp_cmd_parser.c \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Src/isp_core.c \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Src/isp_services.c \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/modcamera.c \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/stubs.c

INC += \
    -I$(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW \
    -I$(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/sensors \
    -I$(CAMERA_DIR)/CMW/sensors/imx335 \
    -I$(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Inc

LIBS += \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Lib/libn6-evision-st-ae_gcc.a \
    $(CAMERA_DIR)/ISP/Lib/libn6-evision-awb_gcc.a
LIBS += $(shell $(CC) $(CFLAGS) -print-file-name=libm.a)
endif

# MicroPython settings
MICROPY_FLOAT_IMPL = double
MICROPY_PY_LWIP = 1
MICROPY_PY_SSL = 1
MICROPY_SSL_MBEDTLS = 1

79	    {

96	void board_userled(int led, bool ledon)
97	{
98	  if ((unsigned)led < nitems(g_ledcfg))
99	    {

101	
102	      stm32_gpiowrite(g_ledcfg[led], !ledon);
103	    }

112	 *   is available to control the LED from user application logic.

#
# This board runs on STM32N657X0 (Cortex-M55, ARMv8.1-M) with
# external MX25UM51245G XSPI flash.  Currently configured for

if ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM

config STM32N6_XSPI
	bool "XSPI external flash support"
	default n
	---help---
		Enable the XSPI (Extended SPI) driver for external flash
		on STM32N6 boards.  This supports Macronix MX25UM series
		NOR flash in SPI and Octal DTR modes with memory-mapped
		XIP (Execute-In-Place) capability.

if STM32N6_XSPI

config STM32N6_XSPI_PRESCALER
	int "XSPI clock prescaler"
	default 4
	---help---
		XSPI clock = HCLK / prescaler.
		With HCLK=50MHz and prescaler=4, XSPI clock = 12.5MHz.
		Lower values give faster flash access but may be unstable.

endif # STM32N6_XSPI

config STM32N6_FSBL
	bool "Build as FSBL (First Stage Boot Loader)"
	default n
	depends on STM32N6_XSPI
	---help---
		Build this image as an FSBL that initializes XSPI flash
		and jumps to the main application.  The FSBL runs from
		SRAM2 after being loaded by the hardware boot ROM.

#ifndef RCC_AHB5ENR_MCE1EN

#define RCC_AHB5LPENR_MCE4LPEN                 (0U)
#define RCC_AHB5ENSR_MCE1ENS                   (0U)
#define RCC_AHB5ENSR_MCE2ENS                   (0U)
#define RCC_AHB5ENSR_MCE3ENS                   (0U)

/* Clocking *****************************************************************/

/* Clock tree (PLL1 fed from the external 48 MHz HSE crystal):
 *
 *   HSE 48 MHz / M=6 * N=100 = 800 MHz VCO
 *     IC1  /4 = 200 MHz  -> CPU clock (CPUSW)

#define STM32_PLL1_M            6
#define STM32_PLL1_N            100
#define STM32_PLL1_IC1_DIV      4

#define STM32_CPUCLK_FREQUENCY  200000000ul
#define STM32_SYSCLK_FREQUENCY  (STM32_CPUCLK_FREQUENCY / 2)
#define STM32_HCLK_FREQUENCY    (STM32_CPUCLK_FREQUENCY / 4)
#define STM32_PCLK1_FREQUENCY   STM32_HCLK_FREQUENCY
#define STM32_PCLK2_FREQUENCY   STM32_HCLK_FREQUENCY

#define STM32_APB1_TIM_FREQUENCY STM32_SYSCLK_FREQUENCY
#define STM32_APB2_TIM_FREQUENCY STM32_SYSCLK_FREQUENCY

/* The DNN647 has multiple I/O voltage domains:
 *   VDDIO2 = 3.3V (most GPIOs)
 *   VDDIO3 = 1.8V (PN/PO/PP ports)
 *   VDDIO4 = 3.3V (PG port)
 */

#define BOARD_PWR_VDDIO  (PWR_SVMCR3_VDDIO2SV    | PWR_SVMCR3_VDDIO3SV | \
                          PWR_SVMCR3_VDDIO2VRSEL | PWR_SVMCR3_VDDIO3VRSEL)

/* LED definitions **********************************************************/

/* The ATK-DNN647 has two user LEDs:
 *
 *   LED0  PG10  (active low)
 *   LED1  PE10  (active low)
 *
 * They are not used by the board port unless CONFIG_ARCH_LEDS is defined.
 */

/* LED index values for use with board_userled() */

#define BOARD_LED1        0
#define BOARD_LED2        1
#define BOARD_NLEDS       2

#define BOARD_LED_RED     BOARD_LED1
#define BOARD_LED_GREEN   BOARD_LED2

/* LED bits for use with board_userled_all() */

#define BOARD_LED2_BIT    (1 << BOARD_LED2)

 *                                                        LED0   LED1
 *   ----------------------  --------------------------  ------ ------

#define LED_STARTED        0 /* NuttX has been started   OFF    OFF   */
#define LED_HEAPALLOCATE   1 /* Heap has been allocated  OFF    ON    */
#define LED_IRQSENABLED    2 /* Interrupts enabled       ON     OFF   */
#define LED_STACKCREATED   3 /* Idle stack created       ON     ON    */

#define LED_SIGNAL         5 /* In a signal handler      GLOW   N/C   */

#define LED_IDLE           8 /* MCU is in sleep mode     ON     OFF   */

/* Alternate function pin selections ****************************************/

#define GPIO_USART1_TX   GPIO_USART1_TX_1
#define GPIO_USART1_RX   GPIO_USART1_RX_1

 *

void stm32_board_initialize(void);

#undef EXTERN
#if defined(__cplusplus)
}
#endif

#endif /* __ASSEMBLY__ */
#endif /* __BOARDS_ARM_STM32N6_ATK_DNN647_INCLUDE_BOARD_H */

LINK_INCLUDE_DIR=$(BOARD_DIR)/include

	ifneq ($(strip $(BOARD_COMMON_DIR)),)
		LINK_INCLUDE_DIR = $(BOARD_COMMON_DIR)/include
	endif

include/arch/board: | include/arch
	@echo "LN: $@ to $(BOARD_DIR)/include"
	$(Q) $(DIRLINK) $(LINK_INCLUDE_DIR) $@

# Link the boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/src dir to arch/<arch-name>/src/board/board

ifneq ($(BOARD_COMMON_DIR),)
ARCH_SRC_BOARD_SYMLINK=$(BOARD_COMMON_DIR)
ARCH_SRC_BOARD_BOARD_SYMLINK=$(BOARD_DIR)/src

ARCH_SRC_BOARD_SYMLINK=$(BOARD_DIR)/src

	$(Q) $(DIRLINK) $(ARCH_SRC_BOARD_SYMLINK) $@

$(ARCH_SRC)/board/board: | $(ARCH_SRC)/board
	@echo "LN: $@ to $(ARCH_SRC_BOARD_BOARD_SYMLINK)"
	$(Q) $(DIRLINK) $(ARCH_SRC_BOARD_BOARD_SYMLINK) $@

drivers/platform:
	@echo "LN: $@ to $(BOARD_DRIVERS_DIR)"

arch/dummy/Kconfig:
	@echo "CP: $@ to $(CHIP_KCONFIG)"

.PHONY: clean_dirlinks

# NuttX buildroot under Linux or Cygwin

ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARM_TOOLCHAIN_BUILDROOT),y)
  TARGET_TOOL := -nuttx-eabi-
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARM_TOOLCHAIN_BUILDROOT_OABI),y)
  TARGET_TOOL := -nuttx-elf-
else ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARM_TOOLCHAIN_GNU_EABI),y)
  TARGET_TOOL := -none-eabi-
endif

ifneq ($(TARGET_TOOL),)
  ifeq ($(CONFIG_ENDIAN_BIG),y)

    # Fallback to common toolchain if "armeb" is unavailable

    ifeq ($(shell command -v armeb$(TARGET_TOOL)gcc 2> /dev/null),)
      TARGET_ARCH := arm
      ARCHCPUFLAGS += -mlittle-endian
    else
      TARGET_ARCH := armeb
      ARCHCPUFLAGS += -mbig-endian
    endif
  else
    ARCHCPUFLAGS += -mlittle-endian
    TARGET_ARCH := arm
  endif

  CROSSDEV ?= $(TARGET_ARCH)$(TARGET_TOOL)
endif

ARCHCPUFLAGS += $(TOOLCHAIN_MARCH) $(TOOLCHAIN_MTUNE) $(TOOLCHAIN_MFLOAT)

ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARM_THUMB),y)
  ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARM_TOOLCHAIN_GHS),y)
    ARCHCPUFLAGS += -thumb
  else
    ARCHCPUFLAGS += -mthumb

    # GCC Manual:

    # code, either add a `.thumb' directive to the source or pass the
    # -mthumb option directly to the assembler by prefixing it with -Wa.

    ARCHCPUFLAGS += -Wa,-mthumb

    # Outputs an implicit IT block when there is a conditional instruction
    # without an enclosing IT block.

#!/bin/bash
# ATK-DNN647 NuttX 板级适配补丁脚本
# 用法: cd nuttx && bash /path/to/apply-patch.sh

set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
NUTTX_DIR="$(pwd)"

echo "=== ATK-DNN647 NuttX 板级适配 ==="
echo "NuttX 目录: $NUTTX_DIR"
echo "补丁目录: $SCRIPT_DIR"
echo ""

# 1. 复制板级支持文件
echo "[1/6] 复制板级支持文件..."
cp -r "$SCRIPT_DIR/atk-dnn647-board" "$NUTTX_DIR/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647"
echo "  完成: boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/"

# 2. 复制修改的架构文件
echo "[2/6] 复制修改的架构文件..."
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/modified/stm32n6/Kconfig" "$NUTTX_DIR/arch/arm/src/stm32n6/Kconfig"
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/modified/stm32n6/stm32n6xxx_rcc.h" "$NUTTX_DIR/arch/arm/src/stm32n6/hardware/stm32n6xxx_rcc.h"
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/modified/stm32n6/stm32n6xx_rcc.c" "$NUTTX_DIR/arch/arm/src/stm32n6/stm32n6xx_rcc.c"
echo "  完成: arch/arm/src/stm32n6/"

# 3. 复制修改的 boards/Kconfig
echo "[3/6] 复制修改的 boards/Kconfig..."
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/modified/boards/Kconfig" "$NUTTX_DIR/boards/Kconfig"
echo "  完成: boards/Kconfig"

# 4. 复制修改的源文件
echo "[4/6] 复制修改的源文件..."
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/modified/drivers/drivers_initialize.c" "$NUTTX_DIR/drivers/drivers_initialize.c"
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/modified/sched/nx_start.c" "$NUTTX_DIR/sched/init/nx_start.c"
echo "  完成: drivers/drivers_initialize.c, sched/init/nx_start.c"

# 5. 修复 Kconfig 语法错误
echo "[5/6] 修复 Kconfig 语法错误..."

# 修复 --help-- / -help- -> help
find "$NUTTX_DIR/arch/tricore" -name "Kconfig*" -exec sed -i 's/--help--/help/g; s/-help-/help/g' {} + 2>/dev/null || true
find "$NUTTX_DIR/arch/risc-v" -name "Kconfig*" -exec sed -i 's/--help--/help/g; s/-help-/help/g' {} + 2>/dev/null || true
find "$NUTTX_DIR/drivers/hwtracing" -name "Kconfig*" -exec sed -i 's/---help---/help/g' {} + 2>/dev/null || true
echo "  修复了 --help-- 语法"

# 修复 osource -> source
find "$NUTTX_DIR/external" -name "Kconfig*" -exec sed -i 's/osource /source /g' {} + 2>/dev/null || true
find "$NUTTX_DIR/apps" -name "Kconfig*" -exec sed -i 's/osource /source /g' {} + 2>/dev/null || true
find "$NUTTX_DIR/frameworks" -name "Kconfig*" -exec sed -i 's/osource /source /g' {} + 2>/dev/null || true
echo "  修复了 osource 语法"

# 修复 zblue endmenu 注释
sed -i 's/^endmenu #.*/endmenu/' "$NUTTX_DIR/external/zblue/Kconfig.3_0_1" 2>/dev/null || true
sed -i 's/^endmenu #.*/endmenu/' "$NUTTX_DIR/external/zblue/Kconfig.default" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "  修复了 zblue endmenu"

# 修复 multimedia endif 注释
sed -i 's/endif # MEDIA TRIGGER/endif # MEDIA_TRIGGER/' "$NUTTX_DIR/frameworks/multimedia/media/Kconfig" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "  修复了 multimedia endif"

# 注释掉有问题的 ril 和 zblue Kconfig
sed -i 's|^source "/home/warner/openvela/external/ril/Kconfig"|# source "/home/warner/openvela/external/ril/Kconfig"|' "$NUTTX_DIR/apps/external/Kconfig" 2>/dev/null || true
# 注意: zblue 的路径需要根据实际环境调整
echo "  注释掉了有问题的外部 Kconfig"

# 创建缺失的 proprietary Kconfig
mkdir -p "$NUTTX_DIR/apps/frameworks/runtimes/quickapp/proprietary" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "# Empty proprietary Kconfig" > "$NUTTX_DIR/apps/frameworks/runtimes/quickapp/proprietary/Kconfig" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "  创建了缺失的 proprietary/Kconfig"

# 6. 完成
echo ""
echo "[6/6] 补丁应用完成!"
echo ""
echo "接下来请执行:"
echo "  cd $NUTTX_DIR"
echo "  make distclean"
echo "  tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:nsh"
echo "  export PATH=\"/path/to/arm-gnu-toolchain/bin:\$PATH\""
echo "  make -j\$(nproc)"
echo ""
echo "注意: 如果 Kconfig 路径需要调整，请手动编辑 apps/external/Kconfig 中的 ril/zblue 路径"

# ATK-DNN647 NuttX 板级适配补丁

## 概述

本补丁为正点原子 ATK-DNN647 开发板（STM32N647X0 MCU）添加 NuttX 基本支持，参考 nucleo-n657x0-q 开发板。

## 硬件特性

- **MCU**: STM32N647X0 (Cortex-M55, ARMv8-M)
- **HSE**: 48 MHz 晶振
- **CPU**: 200 MHz (PLL1: HSE/6*100/4)
- **LED**: LED0=PG10(红), LED1=PE10(绿)，低电平有效
- **串口**: USART1 (PE5/PE6)
- **SRAM**: 0x34000400, 4MB

## 文件说明

### 新增文件 (atk-dnn647-board/)

```
atk-dnn647-board/
├── Kconfig                    # 板级 Kconfig
├── CMakeLists.txt             # CMake 配置
├── include/
│   └── board.h                # 时钟树、LED、USART 配置
├── scripts/
│   ├── flash.ld               # 链接脚本 (SRAM-only)
│   └── Make.defs              # 工具链定义
├── src/
│   ├── dnn647.h               # LED GPIO 定义
│   ├── stm32_boot.c           # 启动初始化
│   ├── stm32_bringup.c        # 后期初始化
│   ├── stm32_autoleds.c       # 自动 LED 控制
│   ├── stm32_userleds.c       # 用户 LED 控制
│   ├── Make.defs              # 源文件列表
│   └── CMakeLists.txt         # CMake 源文件列表
└── configs/
    ├── nsh/defconfig           # NSH 配置
    └── leds/defconfig          # LED 示例配置
```

### 修改文件 (modified/)

```
modified/
├── stm32n6/
│   ├── Kconfig                # 添加 STM32N647X0 芯片选项
│   ├── stm32n6xxx_rcc.h       # 添加 HSE 寄存器定义
│   └── stm32n6xx_rcc.c        # 添加 HSE 时钟源支持
├── boards/
│   └── Kconfig                # 注册 ATK-DNN647 板
├── drivers/
│   └── drivers_initialize.c   # 修复 usrsock 条件包含
└── sched/
    └── nx_start.c             # 修复 mqueue.h 包含
```

## 使用方法

### 1. 应用补丁

```bash
cd /path/to/nuttx
bash /path/to/apply-patch.sh
```

### 2. 配置和编译

```bash
cd /path/to/nuttx
make distclean
tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:nsh

# 设置 ARM 工具链路径
export PATH="/path/to/arm-gnu-toolchain/bin:$PATH"

# 编译
make -j$(nproc)
```

### 3. 其他配置

```bash
# LED 示例
tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:leds
```

## Kconfig 修复说明

本补丁还修复了 openvela 仓库中多处 Kconfig 语法错误：

1. **--help-- / -help- → help**: tricore, hwtracing, espressif 等
2. **osource → source**: zblue, lvgl, quickapp 等
3. **endif 注释语法**: multimedia
4. **endmenu 注释语法**: zblue
5. **ril/zblue Kconfig**: 注释掉导致解析错误的外部包

## 注意事项

1. 链接脚本使用 SRAM-only 模式（无 Flash）
2. 如果重新下载 openvela，需要重新应用本补丁
3. `apply-patch.sh` 中的路径需要根据实际环境调整

#!/bin/bash
# ATK-DNN647 NuttX 板级适配补丁脚本
# 用法: cd nuttx && bash /path/to/apply-patch.sh

set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
NUTTX_DIR="$(pwd)"

echo "=== ATK-DNN647 NuttX 板级适配 ==="
echo "NuttX 目录: $NUTTX_DIR"
echo "补丁目录: $SCRIPT_DIR"
echo ""

# 1. 复制板级支持文件
echo "[1/6] 复制板级支持文件..."
cp -r "$SCRIPT_DIR/atk-dnn647-board" "$NUTTX_DIR/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647"
echo "  完成: boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/"

# 2. 复制修改的架构文件
echo "[2/6] 复制修改的架构文件..."
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/modified/stm32n6/Kconfig" "$NUTTX_DIR/arch/arm/src/stm32n6/Kconfig"
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/modified/stm32n6/stm32n6xxx_rcc.h" "$NUTTX_DIR/arch/arm/src/stm32n6/hardware/stm32n6xxx_rcc.h"
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/modified/stm32n6/stm32n6xx_rcc.c" "$NUTTX_DIR/arch/arm/src/stm32n6/stm32n6xx_rcc.c"
echo "  完成: arch/arm/src/stm32n6/"

# 3. 复制修改的 boards/Kconfig
echo "[3/6] 复制修改的 boards/Kconfig..."
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/modified/boards/Kconfig" "$NUTTX_DIR/boards/Kconfig"
echo "  完成: boards/Kconfig"

# 4. 复制修改的源文件
echo "[4/6] 复制修改的源文件..."
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/modified/drivers/drivers_initialize.c" "$NUTTX_DIR/drivers/drivers_initialize.c"
cp "$SCRIPT_DIR/modified/sched/nx_start.c" "$NUTTX_DIR/sched/init/nx_start.c"
echo "  完成: drivers/drivers_initialize.c, sched/init/nx_start.c"

# 5. 修复 Kconfig 语法错误
echo "[5/6] 修复 Kconfig 语法错误..."

# 修复 --help-- / -help- -> help
find "$NUTTX_DIR/arch/tricore" -name "Kconfig*" -exec sed -i 's/--help--/help/g; s/-help-/help/g' {} + 2>/dev/null || true
find "$NUTTX_DIR/arch/risc-v" -name "Kconfig*" -exec sed -i 's/--help--/help/g; s/-help-/help/g' {} + 2>/dev/null || true
find "$NUTTX_DIR/drivers/hwtracing" -name "Kconfig*" -exec sed -i 's/---help---/help/g' {} + 2>/dev/null || true
echo "  修复了 --help-- 语法"

# 修复 osource -> source
find "$NUTTX_DIR/external" -name "Kconfig*" -exec sed -i 's/osource /source /g' {} + 2>/dev/null || true
find "$NUTTX_DIR/apps" -name "Kconfig*" -exec sed -i 's/osource /source /g' {} + 2>/dev/null || true
find "$NUTTX_DIR/frameworks" -name "Kconfig*" -exec sed -i 's/osource /source /g' {} + 2>/dev/null || true
echo "  修复了 osource 语法"

# 修复 zblue endmenu 注释
sed -i 's/^endmenu #.*/endmenu/' "$NUTTX_DIR/external/zblue/Kconfig.3_0_1" 2>/dev/null || true
sed -i 's/^endmenu #.*/endmenu/' "$NUTTX_DIR/external/zblue/Kconfig.default" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "  修复了 zblue endmenu"

# 修复 multimedia endif 注释
sed -i 's/endif # MEDIA TRIGGER/endif # MEDIA_TRIGGER/' "$NUTTX_DIR/frameworks/multimedia/media/Kconfig" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "  修复了 multimedia endif"

# 注释掉有问题的 ril 和 zblue Kconfig
sed -i 's|^source "/home/warner/openvela/external/ril/Kconfig"|# source "/home/warner/openvela/external/ril/Kconfig"|' "$NUTTX_DIR/apps/external/Kconfig" 2>/dev/null || true
# 注意: zblue 的路径需要根据实际环境调整
echo "  注释掉了有问题的外部 Kconfig"

# 创建缺失的 proprietary Kconfig
mkdir -p "$NUTTX_DIR/apps/frameworks/runtimes/quickapp/proprietary" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "# Empty proprietary Kconfig" > "$NUTTX_DIR/apps/frameworks/runtimes/quickapp/proprietary/Kconfig" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "  创建了缺失的 proprietary/Kconfig"

# 6. 完成
echo ""
echo "[6/6] 补丁应用完成!"
echo ""
echo "接下来请执行:"
echo "  cd $NUTTX_DIR"
echo "  make distclean"
echo "  tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:nsh"
echo "  export PATH=\"/path/to/arm-gnu-toolchain/bin:\$PATH\""
echo "  make -j\$(nproc)"
echo ""
echo "注意: 如果 Kconfig 路径需要调整，请手动编辑 apps/external/Kconfig 中的 ril/zblue 路径"

# ATK-DNN647 NuttX 板级适配补丁

## 概述

本补丁为正点原子 ATK-DNN647 开发板（STM32N647X0 MCU）添加 NuttX 基本支持，参考 nucleo-n657x0-q 开发板。

## 硬件特性

- **MCU**: STM32N647X0 (Cortex-M55, ARMv8-M)
- **HSE**: 48 MHz 晶振
- **CPU**: 200 MHz (PLL1: HSE/6*100/4)
- **LED**: LED0=PG10(红), LED1=PE10(绿)，低电平有效
- **串口**: USART1 (PE5/PE6)
- **SRAM**: 0x34000400, 4MB

## 文件说明

### 新增文件 (atk-dnn647-board/)

```
atk-dnn647-board/
├── Kconfig                    # 板级 Kconfig
├── CMakeLists.txt             # CMake 配置
├── include/
│   └── board.h                # 时钟树、LED、USART 配置
├── scripts/
│   ├── flash.ld               # 链接脚本 (SRAM-only)
│   └── Make.defs              # 工具链定义
├── src/
│   ├── dnn647.h               # LED GPIO 定义
│   ├── stm32_boot.c           # 启动初始化
│   ├── stm32_bringup.c        # 后期初始化
│   ├── stm32_autoleds.c       # 自动 LED 控制
│   ├── stm32_userleds.c       # 用户 LED 控制
│   ├── Make.defs              # 源文件列表
│   └── CMakeLists.txt         # CMake 源文件列表
└── configs/
    ├── nsh/defconfig           # NSH 配置
    └── leds/defconfig          # LED 示例配置
```

### 修改文件 (modified/)

```
modified/
├── stm32n6/
│   ├── Kconfig                # 添加 STM32N647X0 芯片选项
│   ├── stm32n6xxx_rcc.h       # 添加 HSE 寄存器定义
│   └── stm32n6xx_rcc.c        # 添加 HSE 时钟源支持
├── boards/
│   └── Kconfig                # 注册 ATK-DNN647 板
├── drivers/
│   └── drivers_initialize.c   # 修复 usrsock 条件包含
└── sched/
    └── nx_start.c             # 修复 mqueue.h 包含
```

## 使用方法

### 1. 应用补丁

```bash
cd /path/to/nuttx
bash /path/to/apply-patch.sh
```

### 2. 配置和编译

```bash
cd /path/to/nuttx
make distclean
tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:nsh

# 设置 ARM 工具链路径
export PATH="/path/to/arm-gnu-toolchain/bin:$PATH"

# 编译
make -j$(nproc)
```

### 3. 其他配置

```bash
# LED 示例
tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:leds
```

## Kconfig 修复说明

本补丁还修复了 openvela 仓库中多处 Kconfig 语法错误：

1. **--help-- / -help- → help**: tricore, hwtracing, espressif 等
2. **osource → source**: zblue, lvgl, quickapp 等
3. **endif 注释语法**: multimedia
4. **endmenu 注释语法**: zblue
5. **ril/zblue Kconfig**: 注释掉导致解析错误的外部包

## 注意事项

1. 链接脚本使用 SRAM-only 模式（无 Flash）
2. 如果重新下载 openvela，需要重新应用本补丁
3. `apply-patch.sh` 中的路径需要根据实际环境调整

38	 ****************************************************************************/
39	
40	/* Allow up to 100 milliseconds for the high speed clock to become ready.
41	 * that is a very long delay, but if the clock does not become ready we are
42	 * hosed anyway.
43	 */
44	
45	#define HSIRDY_TIMEOUT  (100 * CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC)
46	#define PLL1RDY_TIMEOUT (100 * CONFIG_BOARD_LOOPSPERMSEC)
47	
48	/****************************************************************************
49	 * Private Functions
50	 ****************************************************************************/
51	
52	/****************************************************************************
53	 * Name: rcc_enableahb4
54	 *
55	 * Description:
56	 *   Enable selected AHB4 peripherals - primarily GPIO clocks and PWR.
57	 *   On STM32N6, GPIO ports A-H and N-Q are on AHB4.
58	 *
59	 ****************************************************************************/
60	
61	static inline void rcc_enableahb4(void)
62	{
63	  /* Use the write-1-to-set ENSR alias rather than a read-modify-write on
64	   * ENR so concurrent producers (e.g. RCC IRQ later) cannot lose bits.
65	   * Matches the ST LL pattern in stm32n6xx_ll_bus.h.
66	   */
67	
68	  putreg32(RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOAEN
69	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOBEN
70	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOCEN
71	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIODEN
72	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOEEN
73	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOFEN
74	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOGEN
75	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOHEN
76	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIONEN
77	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOOEN
78	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOPEN
79	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOQEN
80	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_PWREN,
81	           STM32_RCC_AHB4ENSR);
82	}
83	
84	/****************************************************************************
85	 * Name: rcc_enableapb2
86	 *
87	 * Description:
88	 *   Enable selected APB2 peripherals.
89	 *
90	 ****************************************************************************/
91	
92	static inline void rcc_enableapb2(void)
93	{
94	  uint32_t regval = 0;
95	
96	#ifdef CONFIG_STM32_USART1
97	  regval |= RCC_APB2ENR_USART1EN;
98	#endif
99	
100	  if (regval != 0)
101	    {
102	      putreg32(regval, STM32_RCC_APB2ENSR);
103	    }
104	}

111	 * Name: stm32_rcc_enableperipherals
112	 ****************************************************************************/
113	
114	void stm32_rcc_enableperipherals(void)
115	{
116	  /* Enable all AXISRAM bank clocks.  The boot ROM only enables AXISRAM1/2
117	   * which is sufficient for code execution, but the NuttX heap extends
118	   * across all SRAM banks (up to AXISRAM5 at 0x34400000+).  Without these
119	   * clocks, mm_initialize writing the tail node at the heap end will cause
120	   * an IMPRECISERR bus fault.
121	   */
122	
123	  putreg32(RCC_MEMENR_ALLAXISRAM | RCC_MEMENR_CACHEAXIRAMEN,
124	           STM32_RCC_MEMENSR);

126	  rcc_enableahb4();
127	  rcc_enableapb2();
128	}

130	/****************************************************************************
131	 * Name: stm32_stdclockconfig
132	 *
133	 * Description:
134	 *   Configure PLL1 from values supplied by board.h (M, N, IC1_DIV).  The
135	 *   clock tree is laid out in the board header; see board.h for the full
136	 *   diagram.
137	 *
138	 *   IMPORTANT: CFGR1 locks after the first write -- CPUSW and SYSSW must
139	 *   be written together in a single putreg32().  CFGR2 (bus prescalers)
140	 *   also locks after CFGR1 is written, so it must be set first.
141	 *
142	 ****************************************************************************/
143	
144	void stm32_stdclockconfig(void)
145	{
146	  volatile int32_t timeout;
147	  uint32_t regval;
148	
149	  /* If clocks are already configured (e.g. FSBL set up PLL1 and switched
150	   * CPUSW to IC1), skip PLL1/CFGR1 reconfiguration.  CFGR1 locks after
151	   * the first write - a second write crashes the system (SRAM goes
152	   * offline).
153	   */
154	
155	  regval = getreg32(STM32_RCC_CFGR1);
156	  if ((regval & RCC_CFGR1_CPUSWS_MASK) == RCC_CFGR1_CPUSWS_IC1 &&
157	      (regval & RCC_CFGR1_SYSSWS_MASK) == RCC_CFGR1_SYSSWS_IC2_IC6_IC11)
158	    {
159	      return;
160	    }
161	
162	  for (timeout = HSIRDY_TIMEOUT; timeout > 0; timeout--)
163	    {
164	      if ((getreg32(STM32_RCC_SR) & RCC_SR_HSIRDY) != 0)
165	        {
166	          break;
167	        }
168	    }
169	
170	  putreg32(RCC_CR_PLL1ON, STM32_RCC_CCR);
171	
172	  for (timeout = PLL1RDY_TIMEOUT; timeout > 0; timeout--)
173	    {
174	      if ((getreg32(STM32_RCC_SR) & RCC_SR_PLL1RDY) == 0)
175	        {
176	          break;
177	        }
178	    }
179	
180	  regval = (RCC_PLL1CFGR1_SEL_HSI)
181	         | (STM32_PLL1_M << RCC_PLL1CFGR1_DIVM_SHIFT)
182	         | (STM32_PLL1_N << RCC_PLL1CFGR1_DIVN_SHIFT);
183	  putreg32(regval, STM32_RCC_PLL1CFGR1);
184	
185	  regval = RCC_PLL1CFGR3_MODSSDIS
186	         | RCC_PLL1CFGR3_PDIVEN
187	         | (1 << RCC_PLL1CFGR3_PDIV1_SHIFT)
188	         | (1 << RCC_PLL1CFGR3_PDIV2_SHIFT);
189	  putreg32(regval, STM32_RCC_PLL1CFGR3);
190	
191	  putreg32(RCC_CR_PLL1ON, STM32_RCC_CSR);
192	
193	  for (timeout = PLL1RDY_TIMEOUT; timeout > 0; timeout--)
194	    {
195	      if ((getreg32(STM32_RCC_SR) & RCC_SR_PLL1RDY) != 0)
196	        {

198	        }
199	    }

65	   * ENR so concurrent producers (e.g. RCC IRQ later) cannot lose bits.
66	   * Matches the ST LL pattern in stm32n6xx_ll_bus.h.

73	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOEEN

79	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOPEN

81	           | RCC_AHB4ENR_PWREN,
82	           STM32_RCC_AHB4ENSR);

118	   * which is sufficient for code execution, but the NuttX heap extends
119	   * across all SRAM banks (up to AXISRAM5 at 0x34400000+).  Without these
120	   * clocks, mm_initialize writing the tail node at the heap end will cause

136	 *   clock tree is laid out in the board header; see board.h for the full
137	 *   diagram.

140	 *   be written together in a single putreg32().  CFGR2 (bus prescalers)
141	 *   also locks after CFGR1 is written, so it must be set first.
142	 *

145	void stm32_stdclockconfig(void)
146	{
147	  volatile int32_t timeout;
148	  uint32_t regval;
149	
150	  /* If clocks are already configured (e.g. FSBL set up PLL1 and switched

152	   * the first write - a second write crashes the system (SRAM goes
153	   * offline).

155	
156	  regval = getreg32(STM32_RCC_CFGR1);
157	  if ((regval & RCC_CFGR1_CPUSWS_MASK) == RCC_CFGR1_CPUSWS_IC1 &&
158	      (regval & RCC_CFGR1_SYSSWS_MASK) == RCC_CFGR1_SYSSWS_IC2_IC6_IC11)

161	    }

163	#ifdef STM32_HSE_FREQUENCY

166	  putreg32(RCC_CR_HSEON, STM32_RCC_CSR);
167	  for (timeout = HSERDY_TIMEOUT; timeout > 0; timeout--)
168	    {
169	      if ((getreg32(STM32_RCC_SR) & RCC_SR_HSERDY) != 0)
170	        {
171	          break;
172	        }
173	    }
174	#else
175	  for (timeout = HSIRDY_TIMEOUT; timeout > 0; timeout--)
176	    {
177	      if ((getreg32(STM32_RCC_SR) & RCC_SR_HSIRDY) != 0)
178	        {

180	        }
181	    }

185

208	         | (1 << RCC_PLL1CFGR3_PDIV2_SHIFT);

include ${TOPDIR}/.config
include ${TOPDIR}/tools/Config.mk
include ${TOPDIR}/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/Toolchain.defs

ARCHSCRIPT += $(BOARD_DIR)$(DELIM)scripts$(DELIM)flash.ld

CFLAGS := $(ARCHCFLAGS) $(ARCHOPTIMIZATION) $(ARCHCPUFLAGS) $(ARCHINCLUDES) $(ARCHDEFINES) $(EXTRAFLAGS)
CXXFLAGS := $(ARCHCXXFLAGS) $(ARCHOPTIMIZATION) $(ARCHCPUFLAGS) $(ARCHXXINCLUDES) $(ARCHDEFINES) $(EXTRAFLAGS)
CPPFLAGS := $(ARCHINCLUDES) $(ARCHDEFINES) $(EXTRAFLAGS)
AFLAGS := $(CFLAGS) -D__ASSEMBLY__

NXFLATLDFLAGS1 = -r -d -warn-common
NXFLATLDFLAGS2 = $(NXFLATLDFLAGS1) -T$(TOPDIR)$(DELIM)binfmt$(DELIM)libnxflat$(DELIM)gnu-nxflat-pcrel.ld -no-check-sections
LDNXFLATFLAGS = -e main -s 2048

# The start-up, "head", file.  Only common vectors are supported so there

HEAD_ASRC =

# Common ARM and Cortex-M55 files (ARMv8-M base)

include armv8-m/Make.defs

# Required STM32N6 files

CHIP_CSRCS += stm32_gpio.c stm32_irq.c stm32_lowputc.c stm32_rcc.c
CHIP_CSRCS += stm32_start.c stm32_pwr.c stm32_timerisr.c

ifneq ($(CONFIG_ARCH_IDLE_CUSTOM),y)

content.thinking:
I see. When neither `CONFIG_PERCPU_ARRAY` nor `CONFIG_PERCPU_SECTION` is defined, the `DECLARE_PER_CPU`, `DEFINE_PER_CPU`, and `this_cpu_var` macros are NOT defined at all. This causes the compilation errors.

The simplest fix is to add `CONFIG_PERCPU_ARRAY=y` to the defconfig. This will make the per-CPU variables simple arrays indexed by CPU number, which is fine for a single-CPU system.

content.text:
我发现了一个根本性的问题。让我向你说明当前的状况：

## 问题分析

openvela 的 fork **深度修改了 NuttX 的核心头文件**，添加了许多上游标准 NuttX 没有的 CONFIG 选项：

| openvela 特有 CONFIG | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `CONFIG_PERCPU_ARRAY` | per-CPU 变量支持 |
| `CONFIG_NCPUS` | CPU 数量 |
| `CONFIG_STREAM_*_BUFFER_SIZE` | 流缓冲区 |
| `CONFIG_FS_LOCK_BUCKET_SIZE` | 文件系统锁 |
| `CONFIG_FS_MQUEUE_VFS_PATH` | mqueue VFS 路径 |
| `CONFIG_MM_NODE_GUARDSIZE` | 内存节点保护 |
| `CONFIG_LIBC_MAX_EXITFUNS` | 退出函数数量 |
| `CONFIG_FS_NEPOLL_DESCRIPTORS` | epoll 描述符 |
| `CONFIG_START_YEAR/MONTH/DAY` | 系统启动日期 |
| `CONFIG_OPTEE_REMOTE_CPU_NAME` | OPTEE 远程 CPU |
| ... 还有更多 |

**上游 NuttX 的 stm32n6 代码**是为标准 NuttX 编写的，不包含这些 CONFIG。而 openvela 修改的核心头文件（`sched.h`、`irq.h`、`fs.h`、`atexit.h` 等）**强制要求**这些 CONFIG 存在。

## 这意味着

简单地把上游 NuttX 的 stm32n6 代码复制到 openvela 中是**不兼容的**。需要逐个添加数十个甚至上百个 missing CONFIG，而且每次修复一个都会暴露新的缺失。

## 建议方案

1. **方案 A**：用 `make menuconfig` 逐个打开所有需要的 Kconfig 选项（工作量大但可行）
2. **方案 B**：找一个 openvela 已有的类似板子（如 sim 或其他 Cortex-M 板子），用它的 defconfig 作为基础模板
3. **方案 C**：修改 openvela 的核心头文件，让它们在这些 CONFIG 不存在时有合理的默认值

你想用哪个方案？方案 B 可能最快——我可以找一个 openvela 已有的 armv8-m 板子的 defconfig，然后在此基础上修改。
我觉得可以尝试方案二，找一个cortex m板子，然后移植到当前的stm32n6，n6是cortex m55内核，openvela并没有，你可以尝试使用类似的m内核板子，然后移植过来

addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - Messages API for directly passing messages to Claude, Tool Runner (`client.beta.messages.tool_runner`) for running an agentic loop over your own tools, manual tool-use loops, Managed Agents for server-hosted agents with a managed sandbox, prompt caching, and general Anthropic SDK usage; (4) Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) - what it is, setting it up for a Slack workspace, `/install-slack-app`; (5) `claude plugin eval` (writing and running plugin eval suites, its JSON/report, sandbox, CI, early-access enablement) and the `/skill-doctor` report. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Bash, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- driver-workflow: NuttX 驱动开发端到端工作流 Agent。支持新驱动开发、改进现有驱动、代码审查、测试生成四种模式，6 步流程 3 次交互覆盖从需求到提交的完整生命周期。Use when starting NuttX driver development, improving existing drivers, conducting code reviews, generating unit tests, or adapting AUTOSAR MCAL modules to NuttX. (Tools: All tools)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

content.text:
**Build succeeded!** 🎉

The ATK-DNN647 board for STM32N647X0 (Cortex-M55) is now compiling successfully in openvela. Here's a summary:

- **Binary**: `nuttx` (ELF32) and `nuttx.bin` (168 KB)
- **Architecture**: ARM, ARMv8.1-M with DSP, Cortex-M55, hard-float ABI
- **Entry point**: `0x34000771` (SRAM region, correct for STM32N6)
- **SRAM usage**: ~179 KB of 4095 KB (4.26%)

Key fixes that got us to a successful build:
1. Added all required openvela-specific CONFIG options (`CONFIG_PERCPU_ARRAY=y`, `CONFIG_NCPUS=1`, `CONFIG_NFILE_DESCRIPTORS_PER_BLOCK=8`, etc.)
2. Fixed Kconfig syntax issues across the repo (tristate→bool, osource→source, --help--→help)
3. Removed `if`/`endif` wrappers in sourced Kconfig files that confused the NuttX parser (tests/testcases/Kconfig, hwtracing/tricoreht/Kconfig)
4. Commented out zblue/ril in `external/Kconfig` and `apps/external/Kconfig`
5. Fixed `<nuttx/debug.h>` → `<debug.h>` in board source files
6. Fixed stm32n6 Make.defs to compile `stm32_serial.c` unconditionally (the `CONFIG_STM32_USART` condition didn't exist for stm32n6)
7. Installed ARM GNU toolchain (13.3) since none was available in the environment
8. Added HSE 48 MHz support for the DNN647 board's crystal

The `external/Kconfig` must be re-edited (comment out zblue/ril lines) after every `make distclean`.

#ifndef __BOARDS_ARM_STM32N6_ATK_DNN647_INCLUDE_BOARD_H

/****************************************************************************
 * Included Files

#include <nuttx/config.h>
#ifndef __ASSEMBLY__
#  include <stdint.h>
#endif

/****************************************************************************
 * Pre-processor Definitions
 ****************************************************************************/

/* Clocking *****************************************************************/

/* Clock tree (PLL1 fed from the external 48 MHz HSE crystal):
 *
 *   HSE 48 MHz / M=6 * N=100 = 800 MHz VCO
 *     IC1  /4 = 200 MHz  -> CPU clock (CPUSW)
 *   HPRE /4  = 50 MHz   -> HCLK
 *   PPRE1 /1 = 50 MHz   -> PCLK1
 *   PPRE2 /1 = 50 MHz   -> PCLK2
 *
 * Works with the default VOS SCALE1, no SMPS overdrive required.
 */

#define STM32_HSE_FREQUENCY     48000000ul

#define STM32_PLL1_M            6
#define STM32_PLL1_N            100
#define STM32_PLL1_IC1_DIV      4

#define STM32_CPUCLK_FREQUENCY  200000000ul
#define STM32_SYSCLK_FREQUENCY  (STM32_CPUCLK_FREQUENCY / 2)
#define STM32_HCLK_FREQUENCY    (STM32_CPUCLK_FREQUENCY / 4)
#define STM32_PCLK1_FREQUENCY   STM32_HCLK_FREQUENCY
#define STM32_PCLK2_FREQUENCY   STM32_HCLK_FREQUENCY

/* Timer input clock = SYSCLK (TIMPRE=0 default) */

#define STM32_APB1_TIM_FREQUENCY STM32_SYSCLK_FREQUENCY
#define STM32_APB2_TIM_FREQUENCY STM32_SYSCLK_FREQUENCY

/* I/O voltage domains ******************************************************/

/* The DNN647 has multiple I/O voltage domains:
 *   VDDIO2 = 3.3V (most GPIOs)
 *   VDDIO3 = 1.8V (PN/PO/PP ports)
 *   VDDIO4 = 3.3V (PG port)
 */

#define BOARD_PWR_VDDIO  (PWR_SVMCR3_VDDIO2SV    | PWR_SVMCR3_VDDIO3SV | \
                          PWR_SVMCR3_VDDIO2VRSEL | PWR_SVMCR3_VDDIO3VRSEL)

/* LED definitions **********************************************************/

/* The ATK-DNN647 has two user LEDs:
 *
 *   LED0  PG10  (active low)
 *   LED1  PE10  (active low)
 *
 * They are not used by the board port unless CONFIG_ARCH_LEDS is defined.
 */

/* LED index values for use with board_userled() */

#define BOARD_LED1        0
#define BOARD_LED2        1
#define BOARD_NLEDS       2

#define BOARD_LED_RED     BOARD_LED1
#define BOARD_LED_GREEN   BOARD_LED2

/* LED bits for use with board_userled_all() */

#define BOARD_LED1_BIT    (1 << BOARD_LED1)
#define BOARD_LED2_BIT    (1 << BOARD_LED2)

/* If CONFIG_ARCH_LEDS is defined, the LEDs are used to encode OS-related
 * events as follows:
 *
 *   SYMBOL                     Meaning                      LED state
 *                                                        LED0   LED1
 *   ----------------------  --------------------------  ------ ------
 */

#define LED_STARTED        0 /* NuttX has been started   OFF    OFF   */
#define LED_HEAPALLOCATE   1 /* Heap has been allocated  OFF    ON    */
#define LED_IRQSENABLED    2 /* Interrupts enabled       ON     OFF   */
#define LED_STACKCREATED   3 /* Idle stack created       ON     ON    */
#define LED_INIRQ          4 /* In an interrupt          N/C    GLOW  */
#define LED_SIGNAL         5 /* In a signal handler      GLOW   N/C   */
#define LED_ASSERTION      6 /* An assertion failed      GLOW   GLOW  */
#define LED_PANIC          7 /* The system has crashed   Blink  N/C   */
#define LED_IDLE           8 /* MCU is in sleep mode     ON     OFF   */

/* Alternate function pin selections ****************************************/

/* USART1 GPIOs *************************************************************/

/* USART1 (DNN647 console header): PE5=TX (AF7), PE6=RX (AF7) */

#define GPIO_USART1_TX   GPIO_USART1_TX_1
#define GPIO_USART1_RX   GPIO_USART1_RX_1

extern "C"
{

#endif

/****************************************************************************

 * Description:
 *   All STM32N6 architectures must provide the following entry point.
 *   This entry point is called early in the initialization -- after all
 *   memory has been configured and mapped but before any devices
 *   have been initialized.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void stm32_board_initialize(void);

}

101	void __start_c(void) noinstrument_function;
102	
103	/****************************************************************************
104	 * Name: __start
105	 *
106	 * Description:
107	 *   Reset entry point.  The STM32N6 boot ROM (DEV mode) leaves MSPLIM and
108	 *   PSPLIM set such that the first stack push from C code can fault.
109	 *   This function is naked so the limits can be cleared before any
110	 *   compiler-generated prologue runs.  It then tail-calls __start_c.
111	 *
112	 ****************************************************************************/
113	
114	void __attribute__((naked)) noinstrument_function __start(void)
115	{
116	  __asm__ volatile ("mov r0, #0\n\t"
117	                    "msr msplim, r0\n\t"
118	                    "msr psplim, r0\n\t"
119	                    "b __start_c\n\t");
120	}
121	
122	/****************************************************************************
123	 * Name: __start_c
124	 *
125	 * Description:
126	 *   The C-level boot path, reached from the naked __start dispatcher.
127	 *
128	 ****************************************************************************/
129	
130	void __start_c(void)
131	{
132	  const uint32_t *src;
133	  uint32_t *dest;
134	
135	  /* The DEV-mode boot ROM leaves VTOR pointing at its own ROM region.  Set
136	   * VTOR to our SRAM vector table before enabling any exception path.
137	   */
138	
139	  putreg32((uint32_t)_vectors, NVIC_VECTAB);
140	
141	  /* When chain-loaded by an FSBL that called HAL_Init(), SysTick may be
142	   * left running.  Disable it and clear any pending interrupt so it does
143	   * not fire before NuttX has attached its handler.
144	   */
145	
146	  putreg32(0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL);
147	  putreg32(NVIC_INTCTRL_PENDSTCLR, NVIC_INTCTRL);
148	
149	  /* Force plain SLEEP (not DEEPSLEEP) on WFI so the system clock keeps
150	   * running and SysTick continues to wake us.  Cleared once here so
151	   * up_idle() does not need to touch it on every idle entry.
152	   */
153	
154	  modifyreg32(NVIC_SYSCON, NVIC_SYSCON_SLEEPDEEP, 0);
155	
156	  /* Enable the FPU before stm32_clockconfig and the rest of init.  With
157	   * hard-float ABI the compiler may emit FPU instructions later, and any
158	   * exception entry will try to push FP context -- both require CP10/CP11.
159	   */
160	
161	  arm_fpuconfig();
162	
163	  /* Clear .bss inline rather than calling memset, so global state is sane
164	   * even if anything depends on it during the rest of __start.
165	   */
166	
167	  for (dest = (uint32_t *)_sbss; dest < (uint32_t *)_ebss; )
168	    {
169	      *dest++ = 0;
170	    }
171	
172	  /* Copy .data from its load address to SRAM.  For SRAM-only DEV-mode
173	   * builds the linker arranges _eronly == _sdata so the copy is skipped;
174	   * the explicit check avoids corrupting .data when alignment padding
175	   * would otherwise leave a gap between _eronly and _sdata.
176	   */
177	
178	  if (&_eronly[0] != &_sdata[0])
179	    {
180	      for (src = (const uint32_t *)_eronly,
181	           dest = (uint32_t *)_sdata; dest < (uint32_t *)_edata;
182	          )
183	        {
184	          *dest++ = *src++;
185	        }
186	    }
187	
188	  stm32_enable_lob();
189	
190	  stm32_clockconfig();
191	
192	  /* Per ES0620, BSECEN must remain set or WFI/sleep fails.  Set it via
193	   * the atomic SET register, together with SYSCFGEN which we need below.
194	   */
195	
196	  putreg32(RCC_APB4HENR_SYSCFGEN | RCC_APB4HENR_BSECEN,
197	           STM32_RCC_APB4HENSR);
198	
199	  /* Enable the LPEN bits that keep clocks running through WFI (CSLEEP).
200	   * Without these, WFI halts the clocks for the AXISRAM banks and any
201	   * enabled peripherals, and the system never wakes up.
202	   */
203	
204	  putreg32(RCC_BUSLPENR_ACLKNLPEN | RCC_BUSLPENR_ACLKNCLPEN,
205	           STM32_RCC_BUSLPENSR);
206	  putreg32(RCC_MEMLPENR_ALLAXISRAM | RCC_MEMLPENR_CACHEAXIRAMLPEN,
207	           STM32_RCC_MEMLPENSR);
208	#ifdef CONFIG_STM32_USART1
209	  putreg32(RCC_APB2LPENR_USART1LPEN, STM32_RCC_APB2LPENSR);
210	#endif
211	
212	  /* Mark the board's I/O voltage domains as supply-valid before any GPIO
213	   * pad is driven.  The mask of PWR_SVMCR3_* bits is board-specific and
214	   * provided by board.h via BOARD_PWR_VDDIO.
215	   */
216	
217	  stm32_pwr_enablevddio(BOARD_PWR_VDDIO);
218	
219	  /* Apply the ES0620 I/O-compensation mitigation (write 0x287) to the
220	   * domains we use.  Only VDDIO2 and VDDIO3 are touched: the other
221	   * VDDIOxCCCR registers cannot be accessed without their VDDIOxSV bit
222	   * set first (separate ES0620 erratum), and only VDDIO2/3 are declared
223	   * supply-valid in BOARD_PWR_VDDIO above.
224	   */
225	
226	  putreg32(SYSCFG_CCCR_ES0620_MANUAL, STM32_SYSCFG_VDDIO2CCCR);
227	  putreg32(SYSCFG_CCCR_ES0620_MANUAL, STM32_SYSCFG_VDDIO3CCCR);
228	  putreg32(SYSCFG_CCCR_ES0620_MANUAL, STM32_SYSCFG_VDDCCCR);
229	
230	  putreg32((uint32_t)_vectors, STM32_SYSCFG_INITSVTORCR);
231	
232	  /* Read-back to ensure prior SYSCFG writes complete */
233	
234	  (void)getreg32(STM32_SYSCFG_VDDCCCR);
235	
236	#ifdef CONFIG_STM32_USART1
237	  /* Route USART1's kernel clock to HSI so the BRR computation is
238	   * independent of any later SYSCLK changes.
239	   */
240	
241	  putreg32(RCC_CCIPR13_USART1SEL_HSI, STM32_RCC_CCIPR13);
242	#endif
243	
244	  stm32_lowsetup();
245	
246	#ifdef USE_EARLYSERIALINIT
247	  arm_earlyserialinit();
248	#endif
249	
250	  stm32_board_initialize();
251	
252	  /* Final DSB+ISB after SCB writes (VTOR, SYSTICK_CTRL, SYSCFG INITSVTORCR)
253	   * before handing off to NuttX.
254	   */
255	
256	  UP_DSB();
257	  UP_ISB();
258	
259	  showprogress('\r');
260	  showprogress('\n');
261	
262	  nx_start();
263	
264	  /* Shouldn't get here */
265	
266	  for (; ; );
267	}

---

## 当前适配进度

### ✅ 已完成

| 模块 | 状态 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| **编译** | ✅ 通过 | `nuttx.bin` 164KB，无错误无警告 |
| **架构** | ✅ 正确 | Cortex-M55, ARMv8.1-M, 硬浮点 |
| **启动代码** | ✅ 完整 | MSPLIM/PSPLIM 清除、VTOR 设置、FPU 使能、BSS 清零 |
| **时钟** | ✅ 配置 | HSE 48MHz → PLL1 → 200MHz CPU |
| **串口** | ✅ 驱动 | USART1 (PE5=TX, PE6=RX)，作为 NSH 控制台 |
| **LED** | ✅ 驱动 | PG10 (红)、PE10 (绿)，active low |
| **GPIO** | ✅ 驱动 | 完整的 STM32N6 GPIO 框架 |
| **NSH Shell** | ✅ 启用 | 内置命令行，支持 builtin apps |
| **链接脚本** | ✅ 正确 | SRAM 从 0x34000400 开始，4MB |

### ⚠️ 需要注意的问题

1. **STM32N647X0 没有内部 Flash** — 代码必须从 SRAM 运行，需要 DEV boot mode
2. **上游代码尚属早期** — 部分外设驱动可能不完整（如 DMA、SPI、I2C 等）
3. **HSE 48MHz 是我们自定义的** — 原始上游代码使用 HSI，需要确认板子确实有 48MHz 晶振

---

## 烧录方法

### 前提条件

1. **STM32N6 开发板设置为 DEV boot mode**（BOOT 引脚配置）
2. **ST-Link V3**（STM32N6 不支持 V2）
3. **USB 连接到板子的调试口**

### 方法一：STM32CubeProgrammer（推荐）

```bash
# 1. 生成 HEX 文件（如果还没有的话）
export PATH="$HOME/opt/arm-gnu-toolchain-13.3.rel1-x86_64-arm-none-eabi/bin:$PATH"
arm-none-eabi-objcopy -O ihex nuttx nuttx.hex

# 2. 用 STM32CubeProgrammer CLI 烧录
# Windows 路径（WSL 下可直接调用 .exe）
/mnt/d/ST/STM32CubeProgrammer/bin/STM32_Programmer_CLI.exe \
  -c port=SWD freq=4000 \
  -w nuttx.hex \
  -g 0x34000400 \
  -rst
```

参数说明：
- `-c port=SWD` — 使用 SWD 调试接口
- `-w nuttx.hex` — 写入固件
- `-g 0x34000400` — 跳转到 SRAM 入口执行
- `-rst` — 复位后执行

### 方法二：STM32CubeIDE（图形界面）

1. 打开 STM32CubeIDE
2. Run → Debug Configurations → STM32 C/C++ Application
3. 新建配置，选择 `nuttx.elf`
4. Debugger 选项卡选择 SWD，频率 4000kHz
5. Startup 选项卡设置 Initial PC 为 `0x34000400`
6. 点击 Debug

### 方法三：OpenOCD（如果支持 STM32N6）

```bash
openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32n6x.cfg \
  -c "program nuttx.elf verify reset exit"
```

> ⚠️ OpenOCD 对 STM32N6 的支持可能还不完善，建议优先使用 STM32CubeProgrammer。

---

## 串口连接

烧录成功后，连接串口控制台：

- **引脚**：PE5 (TX)、PE6 (RX)
- **波特率**：115200
- **数据位**：8，停止位：1，无校验

```bash
# Windows 下用 PuTTY 或 serial tool
# WSL 下可以用 minicom 或 picocom
minicom -D /dev/ttyS? -b 115200
```

如果一切正常，你应该看到 NSH 提示符：

```
NuttShell (NSH) NuttX-12.x.x
nsh>
```

---

## 如果烧录后没有输出

可能的原因和排查：

1. **HSE 晶振不匹配** — 如果板子没有 48MHz 晶振，需要改用 HSI（删除 `STM32_HSE_FREQUENCY` 定义）
2. **串口引脚不对** — 确认 PE5/PE6 确实连到了板子的调试串口
3. **Boot mode 不对** — 确保 BOOT0/BOOT1 设置为 DEV mode
4. **时钟配置错误** — 可以先用 HSI（内部振荡器）排除 HSE 问题

input.content:
#!/bin/bash
# ATK-DNN647 (STM32N6) 构建脚本
# 在独立目录中构建，不污染源码树
#
# 用法: ./build-dnn647.sh [clean]

set -e

NUTTX_SRC="/home/warner/openvela/nuttx"
BUILD_DIR="/home/warner/openvela/build-dnn647"
APPS_DIR="/home/warner/openvela/apps"
EXTERNAL_DIR="/home/warner/openvela/external"
TESTS_DIR="/home/warner/openvela/tests"
FRAMEWORKS_DIR="/home/warner/openvela/frameworks"
PACKAGES_DIR="/home/warner/openvela/packages"
VENDOR_DIR="/home/warner/openvela/vendor"

export PATH="$HOME/opt/arm-gnu-toolchain-13.3.rel1-x86_64-arm-none-eabi/bin:$PATH"

# 清理模式
if [ "$1" = "clean" ]; then
    echo "=== 清理构建目录 ==="
    rm -rf "${BUILD_DIR}"
    echo "已清理"
    exit 0
fi

echo "=== 创建构建目录 ==="
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}"

# 创建符号链接（只在不存在时创建）
create_link() {
    local target="$1"
    local link="$2"
    if [ ! -e "$link" ]; then
        ln -s "$target" "$link"
    fi
}

# 链接 nuttx 源码的核心目录
cd "${BUILD_DIR}"

# nuttx 子目录
for dir in arch boards drivers fs include libs net sched crypto mm openamp wireless; do
    create_link "${NUTTX_SRC}/${dir}" "${dir}"
done

# 链接 nuttx 根目录文件
for f in Makefile Make.defs Kconfig COPYING; do
    create_link "${NUTTX_SRC}/${f}" "${f}"
done

# 链接 tools 目录
create_link "${NUTTX_SRC}/tools" "tools"

# 链接外部目录
create_link "${APPS_DIR}" "apps"
create_link "${EXTERNAL_DIR}" "external"
create_link "${TESTS_DIR}" "tests"
create_link "${FRAMEWORKS_DIR}" "frameworks"
create_link "${PACKAGES_DIR}" "packages"
create_link "${VENDOR_DIR}" "vendor"

# 链接其他可能需要的目录
for dir in bin include/nuttx; do
    if [ -d "${NUTTX_SRC}/${dir}" ] && [ ! -e "${dir}" ]; then
        create_link "${NUTTX_SRC}/${dir}" "${dir}"
    fi
done

echo "=== 配置 ==="
if [ ! -f .config ]; then
    ./tools/configure.sh -l atk-dnn647:nsh
    make olddefconfig
fi

echo "=== 编译 ==="
make -j$(nproc)

echo "=== 生成 HEX ==="
arm-none-eabi-objcopy -O ihex nuttx nuttx.hex

echo ""
echo "=== 构建完成 ==="
ls -lh nuttx nuttx.bin nuttx.hex 2>/dev/null
